scope: Read-only clarity and cultural-framing review; no source-law determination, community approval, or verification of production-completion claims.
overall_assessment: Clear and suitable for the reading edition. No blocking cultural-framing or clarity changes identified.
strengths: Introduces beer as an entry point without assigning all fermented traditions a universal beer identity.
Distinguishes European commercial examples from a universal standard and preserves makers’ own categories.
Names AI assistance, uneven source access, absence of independent specialist and community review, and source-corpus limitations.
Acknowledgments credit makers, translators, farmers, community participants and source creators while explicitly avoiding implied endorsement.
Afterword treats knowledge as maintained through relationships and preserves the limits of different forms of evidence.
Correction instructions invite preferred terminology, disagreement, narrower claims and explicit uncertainty.
